statement: Imported inventory for the Medical Thoracoscopy module. Every item was copied from the owner's planning documents, which are kept outside the repository, and carries the layer and line it came from. Nothing was reconstructed or invented. Nothing in this file is clinical approval, a manufacturer fact-check or a rights permission. Section minutes are authoring estimates and have not been piloted.

imported.text: Full module in about 3–4 months, targeting mid-January 2027.
3D coverage: the Mini-Thoracoscopy Set, the ENDOCAM Logic 4K tower and a generic electrosurgical generator.
Wolf has not yet been asked for CAD, a brand kit or video.
Wolf is the sponsor, and the owner keeps editorial control. This is the site's first sponsored module.
It is a new top-level module at `/[locale]/medical-thoracoscopy`.
The old module is retired, with permanent redirects.

correctedAssumptions.originalProposal: Combine airway colliders using minimum clearance
correctedAssumptions.requiredImprovement: Use explicit cavity-versus-obstacle semantics. The existing airway helper returns positive clearance **inside** its mesh; that convention is wrong for lung obstacles.

correctedAssumptions.originalProposal: Refit a BVH when lung state changes
correctedAssumptions.requiredImprovement: Update CPU collision geometry to match every supported morph state before refitting. GPU morphing alone does not update collision queries.

correctedAssumptions.originalProposal: Tool diameter ≤ channel diameter proves fit
correctedAssumptions.requiredImprovement: Separate dimensional comparison from manufacturer-confirmed compatibility, including market, accessory, valve and adapter combinations.

correctedAssumptions.originalProposal: Matching LPS coordinates establishes ultrasound alignment
correctedAssumptions.requiredImprovement: Verify source-case identity, transforms, units, landmarks and patient position. Shared axis names alone are insufficient.
Model these as prerequisites within a reviewed scenario; they must not guarantee expansion despite non-expandable lung, obstruction or ongoing air leak.

correctedAssumptions.originalProposal: Existing self-paced policy automatically governs this module
correctedAssumptions.requiredImprovement: Explicitly adopt its learning contract for this module; the current document names nine other modules.

correctedAssumptions.originalProposal: Failed week-four gate triggers a reduced simulator
correctedAssumptions.requiredImprovement: Failed gates trigger remediation and schedule revision, consistent with the owner’s full-3D priority.

teachingAdditions.name: opening whole-procedure demonstration
teachingAdditions.text: Open with a short, annotated whole-procedure demonstration before teaching individual components. Use original animation initially; licensed footage can supplement it.

teachingAdditions.name: procedural decision guide
teachingAdditions.text: Retain the four simulator controls, but label them as controls of the model. Add a separate procedural decision guide covering whether to proceed, sample, treat, stop or escalate.

teachingAdditions.name: step, hazard, early sign, first response table
teachingAdditions.text: Keep “Reading the pleura” for visual interpretation. Add a reusable **step → hazard → early sign → first response** table for procedural complications.

modelBoundaries.text: No haptics, tissue forces or bleeding physiology.
Pressure is shown as qualitative authored states.
Pathology and the talc spray are illustrative.
Anatomy the scan doesn't contain (pleura, intercostal muscles, NV bundles) is authored teaching geometry.
Sedation, energy settings and reprocessing follow the IFU and local protocol.
Completing the module is not competence.

items.text: An entry site too low or too anterior-medial.
Biopsy at the inferior rib margin or of mediastinal structures.

governingRule.text: Unsafe actions must not be endorsed, conceal their risks, or generate fabricated procedural success. Their modeled consequences must remain clinically reviewed and causally plausible. A favorable immediate observation does not establish that the action was appropriate or safe.
governingRule.note: Replaces the v1 rule that these actions must never look beneficial. Unsupported consequences are "not modeled".

v1Criteria.text: Median ≥ 45 fps on an M1/Iris Xe laptop and ≥ 30 fps on an A14 iPad at low quality.
Payload ≤ 8 MB; interactive ≤ 4 s fast and ≤ 8 s on throttled 4G.
Zero wall or lung penetration across 10k seeded fuzz commands.
The owner judges the scope view plausible.

v1OnFailure.text: If it fails: authored survey poses with free look only.

v2OnFailure.text: A failed gate triggers repair and a revised forecast, not silent scope reduction.

v2Additions.text: One complete survey lesson using real anatomy, free scope movement, collision, lung transition, visibility, keyboard and accessible alternative; **plus a narrow intentional-tool-contact spike** that proves the intervention contract. Independent geometry fixtures, stale-result tests, real browser rendering, and first hardware measurements are required.

performanceTargets.note: v1 names hardware and, for one target, quality. It names no browser, viewport, network profile or cache state. Those cells are unresolved inputs, not defaults.

rows.target: median frame rate at least 45 fps
